DESIGN BRIEF (print brochure, NOT web cards):
- Avoid stacking identical bordered cards
- Clear typographic hierarchy: cover catch ~20-22pt, section h2 ~11pt, body ≥8pt, scores ≥14pt
- Use color bands, hairline rules, numbered circles, spacing — not gray boxes everywhere
- Dense but readable; fill A4 without huge empty bottom

=== PAMPHLET ===

.pm1 — cover full height flex column
.pm1-photo — absolute or grid full bleed photo behind
.pm1 layout: grid with photo full-bleed; left panel ~55% with dark green translucent panel over photo (NOT solid green wall covering whole page). Right side of photo more visible.
.pm1-panel — padding 10mm; color white; logo white filter; place cyan; h1 serif 20pt white; 
.pm1-core — the differentiator block: white/cyan text, border-left 3px #00c1d2, soft 10pt, goal 14pt serif
.pm1-lead — 8.5pt opacity 0.92 max-width
.pm1-facts — single line, no cards, separators, 8pt
.pm1-bar — bottom strip #003d38, founder photo circle, tel large

.pm — inner pages padding 6mm 7mm, flex column gap ~2.5mm height 100%
.pm-head — kicker + h1, border-bottom 2px #006058; h1 serif 15pt; em #006058
.pm-kicker — 8pt #00a8b8 letter-spacing

.pm2-open — grid 1.1fr 0.9fr
.pm2-worry h2 — 10pt; ul no boxes, dashed bottoms, 8.5pt bold, □ prefix
.pm2-aside — photo 28mm height + short paragraph 8pt
.pm2-core — full width, bg #006058 white text, padding 4mm, centered; soft/goal hierarchy; hint 7.5pt cyan
.pm2-steps — h2; ol 3-col grid NO photos; big circle numbers; title 11pt; body 8pt
.pm2-results — margin-top auto; head row; .pm2-res-row 3 cols; HUGE scores 16pt serif; diff #006058 15pt

.pm3-mech — grid 3 cols text + 1 photo column spanning right OR 3fr+photo: use grid-template-columns 1fr 1fr 1fr 32mm; articles no borders; h3 serif 9.5pt; ul 8pt; .flow cyan bold; .pm3-mech-photo tall cover
.pm3-week — h2; ul flex/grid 4 days, day bold large, no pills overload
.pm3-grades .pm3-grade-row — 3 cols; badge pill #006058; h3 8.5pt; ul 7.5pt no heavy boxes
.pm3-bottom — 2 cols; .pm3-rules ol; .pm3-samples articles with left border cyan only

.pm4-note — left border green, 8pt
.pm4-price — grid table + aside; table clean; aside #0a3d5c white text
.pm4-faq dl — 2 col, NO boxes; dt #006058 bold; dd 7.5pt
.pm4-flow ol — 4 cols numbered, no bordered cards; .key accent; .pm4-diag one line
.pm4-contact — dark green full-bleed footer margin negative; CTA headline; QRs; phone 14pt
